control.name: Missed payment detection and exception monitoring (existing control – proposed scope extension)
control.description:
Draft proposal to map the existing detective control (id cfc87ee5-1894-4627-841b-6e22a084d7c9) to the detection of missed payments under CONC 7.20.1R(1). No recorded test evidence is supplied, so effectiveness is NOT_TESTED. The control's actual design and scope have not been supplied and must be confirmed by a human reviewer. It is assumed not to notify borrowers or provide information, so it does not claim coverage of CONC 7.20.1R(2)(a), (2)(b) or (3). Whether it covers regulated deferred payment credit agreements specifically, and applies the CONC 7.20.1R(4) definition of 'payment' (capital repayment only, excluding charges for non-compliance), needs confirmation.

Addresses: CONC 7.20.1R(1) (detection); CONC 7.20.1R (monitoring).

Requires human confirmation — not verified organisational fact.
